observation.command: echo "=== find API base path from api-docs.json ==="; timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-manager-api/v3/api-docs" -o /tmp/api.json -w "api-docs: %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/api.json'));print('basePath paths sample:'); [print(' ',p) for p in list(d.get('paths',{}).keys())[:6]]" 2>&1 | head
